desc:
Defeat ragdolls, open packs and collect 120 powers in this ragdoll physics game!

Run through a city full of ragdolls that walk, talk and run away screaming. Slice, launch, freeze and blow up ragdolls with your powers to earn coins, then rip open power packs. Watch out for cops, soldiers and heroes trying to stop your rampage!

POWERS
- 120 powers in 6 types: Elements, Heroes, Tech, Mystic, Cosmic and Dark
- Common to Mythic: lightning, black holes, chainsaws, katanas, nukes and lots more
- Every power does something different to a ragdoll's body

THE CITY
- Smash buildings and watch them break apart
- Throw ragdolls into traps: crushers, a shredder, a wrecking ball, a woodchipper, a shark pool and more
- Drive tanks from the military base or take over any car

MORE
- Co-op with up to 4 friends
- Zombie mode: survive the waves
- Thanksgiving event: collect drumsticks and pick a free power

JOIN GROUP: https://www.roblox.com/communities/297623182/Yukky-Toast
